Arizona Candidate Reports Sexual Assault While Repairing Campaign Signs

An Arizona congressional candidate has reported being sexually assaulted while repairing campaign signs. She stated that the incident occurred while she was working on the signs. The candidate believes the attack may have been politically motivated.
